name: Vox2SDF
definition: A neural network pipeline that encodes a 3D voxel grid into a latent vector, then decodes it with a position-conditional MLP to predict signed distance function (SDF) values at arbitrary 3D points.
summary: Vox2SDF converts discrete 3D voxel grids into continuous signed distance fields using a 3D CNN encoder, distinguishing itself by deriving latent codes directly from input geometry rather than relying on global codes.
